messages:
jamie (support): Customer reports intermittent 502s hitting /v1/generate around 2026-03-16 15:02 UTC. They sent back a request_id: req-03e7c9a4. Can someone pull server-side logs? They can reproduce via curl.
lia (customer success): Thanks — can you paste the full request_id + region/account? Also ask the customer to run a quick curl with --verbose and paste output.
jamie (support): region=us-west-2, account=acct-54f3. Here's the curl they ran:
```
curl -v 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4o","input":"hello"}'
```
They get HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway consistently.
ben (eng-runtime): Got it. For Kibana/KQL try:
```
@metadata.request_id:\"req-03e7c9a4\" OR http.request.id:\"req-03e7c9a4\"
index: prod-logs-* | sort @timestamp desc
```
If not in hot indices check s3-archive indices: `prod-logs-archive-*` (cold tier). Hot tier retention = 7d, cold tier = 90d, archive TTL = 730d for compliance buckets.
sre-oncall: I ran the KQL against prod-logs-2026.03.16 (hot) and didn't find entries. Checked prod-logs-archive-2026.03.16 and located a few hits. Partial log:
```
timestamp=2026-03-16T15:02:13Z level=error service=frontend req_id=req-03e7c9a4 status=502 upstream=upstream-01.example.com error=\"upstream reset by peer\" latency_ms=18.7
stack=\"at runtime/handler.go:142 func handleRequest\\n at runtime/proxy.go:88 func proxyRequest\"
```
sre-oncall: Looks like upstream reset, not an internal 5xx from runtime. I can pull the full archived shard export and attach debug bundle. It'll take ~20m to retrieve from cold storage.
jamie (support): Please do — customer needs a summary + any mitigation steps. Also they'd like a curl that reproduces on our side.
ben (eng-runtime): To generate a debug bundle for that req id (gives full traces + logs):
```
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REND_TOKEN\" \
  -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/api/support/debug-bundles \
  -d '{\"request_id\":\"req-03e7c9a4\",\"reason\":\"support_escalation_502\"}'
```
I'll also run a lightweight repro from our staging to confirm upstream health.
log-bot: debug-bundle dbg-20260316-77a created by ben. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/support/bundles/dbg-20260316-77a
lia (customer success): Thanks all — once bundle is ready, can someone attach a short explainer for the customer (what upstream component failed, whether retries help)?
jamie (support): will draft and follow up after SRE attaches full logs.
sre-oncall: Export is queued (job id export-88f). ETA 22 minutes. If we need more immediate mitigation we can suggest the customer enable client-side retries with exponential backoff and increase request timeout to 10s as a short-term workaround.
lia (customer success): noted, passing to customer. :thumbsup:
